cards.question: What does it mean for an operation to be atomic?
cards.answer: It is the smallest operation on data that either occurs or does not. There is no half-done state.

cards.question: What inconsistent update do atomics prevent?
cards.answer: Two threads both reading the same value and updating it at the same time.

cards.question: What do atomic implementations depend on?
cards.answer: The system architecture and OS, including which types are available.
